name: Files
label: Sandbox filesystem
description: Read, write, list, delete files under sandbox tmp only. Never host paths. read/write use type file. watch is kind=ingress (not a StudioQuack Webhook node).
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One Files operation. Set operation (or rely on config). Secrets stay in configurationParameters. Example operation: 'read'.

schema.label: file
schema.description: File ref for write (and result of read). Type file.

schema.label: text
schema.description: Optional UTF-8 body for write when not using file. Supplying text selects write when operation is omitted.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Result as JSON (`status`/`data`). Secrets redacted. File-producing ops also set `file` (type file). Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: file
schema.description: Result file ref when the operation produces a file. Type file (platform ref-id). Never inline bytes.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Operation payload (parsed JSON or engine result). Absent when unused.

schema.label: http_status
schema.description: HTTP status when the op is an official HTTP call. Absent for in-process ops.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Which capability to run. EXACT accepted values: read | write | list | delete | watch. Required. Example: 'read'.

configurationParameters.label: Base Dir
configurationParameters.description: Sandbox-relative root. Default '.'. Host paths rejected.

configurationParameters.label: Encoding
configurationParameters.description: Text encoding for non-file text writes. Default UTF-8.

configurationParameters.label: Watch Glob
configurationParameters.description: Advisory glob for a timer-driven list. Example: '*.csv'.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout Seconds
configurationParameters.description: Connect+read / run budget in seconds. Positive integer. Blank/0/negative → 25. Keep at or below the sandbox request budget. Example: 25.
